errors.text_span: Cardio is represented in orange, Gastro in tan, Infect in orange, Neuro in orange, Obstetrics in orange, and Pediatrics in orange.
errors.evidence: The chart shows each specialty’s fine-tuned bars in a gradient of different warm colors (from very light beige through orange to dark brown), not the repeated color assignments stated in the description.

errors.text_span: The shortest bar in the chart, at approximately -27, is the baseline model fine-tuned on Cardio data; the tallest bar, at about -22, is the model fine-tuned on Obstetrics data.
errors.evidence: The baseline Cardio bar is around -26.8, not approximately -27, and the tallest bar is closer to -22.0, but several other bars are also near the top of the plotted range; the exact tallest bar is not clearly isolated as described.

errors.text_span: Each clinical specialty is represented by a group of three bars
errors.evidence: Each specialty group contains more than three bars: there is one light-blue baseline bar plus multiple specialty fine-tuned bars (about six bars total per group), not three.

errors.text_span: The baseline Mistral-v0.2 is shown as a single light blue bar grouped with each specialty's fine-tuned bars.
errors.evidence: The light-blue baseline bar appears in each group, but there are multiple fine-tuned bars per group, and the description mischaracterizes the grouped set by omitting most of the bars and their distinct colors.
The description does not mention the legend structure indicating 'Mistralv0.2-Base' and 'Fine-tuned on:' followed by the specialty color labels.
The description does not describe that the specialty bars use a consistent left-to-right light-to-dark orange/brown color progression within each group.
